gate_rules.G10_swe_records_order_or_a_library: >= 1 rollout carrying a timestamp or an explicit retrieved-case field, without which 'reuse of historical trajectories' cannot be observed as retrieval
gate_rules.G11_eight_corpora_inventoried: >= 6 of the eight local corpora yield a file count, a row count and a column list, which is all T036's aggregation can be built from
gate_rules.G12_eight_corpus_label_coverage: >= 4 corpora expose an outcome or quality column among their first columns, the ceiling on how many of the eight can carry a labelled claim
gate_rules.G1_codeact_readable: >= 200 code-act conversations with at least one assistant turn, the units T184 types
gate_rules.G2_codeact_has_code_actions: >= 200 conversations containing an executed code block, without which there is no code action to compare with a natural-language one
gate_rules.G3_codeact_has_errors_to_recover_from: >= 100 conversations whose text reports an error, the correctability arm
gate_rules.G4_codeact_has_composition: >= 100 conversations with a multi-statement code block, T184's composition arm
gate_rules.G5_mmat_readable: >= 200 MMAT conversations with at least one <THOUGHT> block
gate_rules.G6_mmat_has_reflection_markers: >= 200 reflection markers followed by a scoreable content pair, below which 'ritual versus corrective' has no events to split
gate_rules.G7_mmat_no_correctness_label: a correctness label must be present for any claim about a reflection making the answer right; the release carries none, so this gate fires by design and the wave reports change instead of correctness
gate_rules.G8_swe_has_prior_attempts: >= 300 instances attempted more than once in the draw, which is T194's reuse material
gate_rules.G9_swe_has_neighbours: >= 1,000 rollouts whose issue text has a neighbour instance at Jaccard >= 0.3, the similar-past-case premise
